question:
Which of the following alternative will fill the blanks?

**pq_st_qr_tp_rst**
solution:
Given series: pq _ st _ qr _ tp _ rst

Option 1) r,p,s,q → pq __**r**__ st __**p**__ qr __**s**__ tp __**q**__ rst → (It follows the pattern of: pqrst - pqrst - pqrst)

Option 2) p,s,q,r → pq __p__ st __s__ qr __q__ tp __r__ rst → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) p,q,s,r → pq __p__ st __q__ qr __s__ tp __r__ rst → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) r,p,q,s → pq __r__ st __p__ qr __q__ tp __s__ rst → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
